description: Fathom is an AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and summarizes video calls across platforms like Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams.
auth_notes: API access typically utilizes API keys or OAuth2 tokens generated through user account or developer settings.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free Fathom account and access developer documentation and API/MCP configuration via the launchpad.
api_notes: Provides programmatic access to meeting data, transcripts, summaries, and integrations.
mcp_notes: Fathom provides an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for integrating meeting data into LLM tools like Claude and ChatGPT.
rationale: Fathom offers public APIs, an official MCP server, and self-serve free account access, making it immediately ready as an agent toolkit.

evidence.note: Official homepage detailing Fathom's integrations, API, and MCP offerings.
Provides free user signup options and launchpad documentation for developers.
References programmatic access via public API and MCP integration features.
Advertises official MCP server support and capabilities for LLM workflows.
